metadata_path_interpretation: The source_manifest field in the preserved metadata.json is an upstream locator, not a local path in this repository.
normalization_scope: Electoral source normalization is inherited as pinned input. The experiments rerun the full allocator from these TSVs; they do not claim a fresh source download or normalization.
source_notice_scope: The independent input-correction guard covers up to four added votes outside the fixed eight parties for the completed interaction grid, under its explicit domain.
